prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
finish, new_flow changes are helpful, delivering 5 wins (+10.9%, +7.1%, +3.6%, +2.9%, +2.2%), though 7 tests showed no clear effect.
home, wait_info changes are helpful, delivering 5 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%, +1.7%), though 7 tests showed no clear effect.
sign_in, reorder is high-risk with 1 win (+12.1%) and 2 severe losses (-7.0%, -7.4%), while adoption, redesign and sign_in, layout failed to yield any wins.
adoption, copy; adoption, layout; sign_in, hint; and home, notification consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.
Single-test kinds (such as adoption, wait_info; choose_path, hint; choose_path, layout; choose_path, reorder; and sign_in, copy) still have thin evidence and do not form established patterns.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak or failing changes while underestimating major unexpected wins.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Interactive Control and Visibility Companion Flow: Adds an interactive guided practice flow on the final screen teaching users how to summon, hide, and speak to their pet on the desktop. (why: Support receives multiple tickets about confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interaction Command Masterclass Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding screen right before completion to demonstrate shortcuts for desktop controls and pet chat commands. (why: Users take a long time on the finish step (mean 5815s) and express uncertainty about pet interaction controls post-setup.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Rendering Desktop Environment Activity Status: Adds dynamic activity log messages and desktop rendering status updates to the waiting screen. (why: Wait_info enhancements on the home stage consistently deliver conversion gains (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7% historical wins).)
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Tray Controls Guided Mastery Flow: Guides users through a hands-on interactive taskbar simulation on home_intro to practice docking and context menu actions. (why: New flow changes at the finish step have achieved major historical wins (+10.9%, +7.1%), direct addressing post-onboarding support issues.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account Sync Pet Retrieval Status Notification: Adds an explicit status notification banner informing returning users that their existing pets will be automatically restored after sign in. (why: The single largest support complaint theme (8 emails) involves pets missing or reset after signing in again.)

scores.note: finish, new_flow has a strong track record of wins and directly addresses support tickets about post-setup controls.
Inserting an entire new screen adds onboarding friction and requires a full release, making it risky despite support evidence.
home, wait_info is a high-confidence pattern with low implementation cost, though the home step already converts well.
Guided mastery interactive flows on finish have delivered major historical wins (+10.9%, +7.1%) and solve post-onboarding confusion.
Sign-in loses 17.4% of users and this targets the single largest support complaint (8 emails) via a simple notification config.
